lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.
You cook on Tuesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Warm mushroom toast
dishes.title: 2 eggs, mushrooms, spinach and toast
dishes.method: Cook the eggs fresh as a soft scramble with the mushrooms and spinach, then serve with toast.
dishes.why: A quick warm breakfast keeps the week moving without using the Thursday kitchen table.

dishes.name: Chicken rice bowl
dishes.title: Chicken, rice and roast vegetables
dishes.method: Take the plated portion from the labelled box and reheat it gently in a pan, then finish with the lemon wedge.
dishes.why: It is a full lunch that comes from one cooking session and works around the dusty Thursday kitchen.

dishes.name: Herb chicken supper
dishes.title: Chicken, rice and roast vegetables
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed portion in a pan and spoon over the yogurt at the end.
dishes.why: Dinner stays warm and filling without requiring a second cooking session.

dishes.name: Window breakfast plate
dishes.title: 2 eggs, mushrooms, spinach and toast
dishes.method: Cook the eggs fresh as a soft scramble with the mushrooms and spinach, then serve with toast.
dishes.why: Thursday needs a fresh breakfast because the kitchen table is out of action later on.

dishes.name: Hallway lunch bowl
dishes.title: Chicken, rice and roast vegetables
dishes.method: Take the boxed portion and reheat it in a pan, then add the lemon wedge.
dishes.why: Lunch is already cooked, which suits the disrupted kitchen table day.

dishes.name: Painter's chicken dinner
dishes.title: Chicken, rice and roast vegetables
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed portion in a pan and stir through the yogurt just before serving.
dishes.why: A hot dinner is still possible even with a lodger sharing the kitchen and the table covered.

dishes.name: Friday mushroom breakfast
dishes.title: 2 eggs, mushrooms, spinach and toast
dishes.method: Cook the eggs fresh as a soft scramble with the mushrooms and spinach, then serve with toast.
dishes.why: Friday starts with another warm plate so the remaining meals stay easy to manage.

dishes.name: Friday lunch bowl
dishes.title: Chicken, rice and roast vegetables
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed portion in a pan and finish with the lemon wedge.
dishes.why: The Friday lunch stays within the three-day limit of the Wednesday cook.

dishes.name: Friday dinner bowl
dishes.title: Chicken, rice and roast vegetables
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed portion in a pan and spoon over the yogurt at the table.
dishes.why: The last batch meal lands before the cooked rice gets too old.

preparations.title: Mushroom and herb frittata
preparations.method: Soften the onion and mushrooms in olive oil, then add the spinach to wilt. Beat the eggs with milk, pour into a lined baking dish, scatter over the vegetables and bake until set. Serve with toasted bread.

preparations.title: Chicken, rice and roast vegetables
preparations.method: Roast the chicken thighs with carrots, courgettes, peppers, onions and garlic until browned and cooked through. Cook the rice separately and fluff it. Mix lemon juice with paprika and a little oil, then toss through the vegetables and chicken before boxing.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Put the oven on, start the rice, and get the chicken and vegetables into the roasting tray. While they cook, soften the onion and mushrooms, then mix and bake the frittata. Cool both batches, cut the breakfast tray, and box the chicken, rice and vegetables into four named portions.

member_portions.portion_note: Serve 220 g cooked chicken, 220 g cooked rice, and 180 g vegetables at lunch and dinner; at breakfast serve 2 eggs, 120 g sautéed mushrooms, and 2 slices toast.

preparation_shares.note: Take one larger box at lunch and dinner, with extra chicken and rice plus the same vegetable mix.
